units.source_text: 我想，就是柏木也不会说他没有酩酊大醉吧。

en.t: I think even Kashiwagi would not say that he was not dead drunk.

units.source_text: 我突然明白任何阴郁的认识里，也会隐藏着足以使认识者陶醉的东西。

en.t: I suddenly understood that within any gloomy perception, there is also something hidden that can intoxicate the one who perceives it.

units.source_text: 而且，酒好歹还是使人陶醉的。

en.t: And besides, wine, whatever else it may be, still intoxicates people.
